actor_caller_type.format: One fixed word; USER on every captured event.

application_name.format: One fixed word naming the Reports API application; the discriminator for this family's 13 sourcetypes.

saml.meaning: SAML sign-in events, Workspace acting as the identity provider.

token.meaning: OAuth token grants and revocations for third-party apps.

access_transparency.meaning: Google staff actions on customer content.

mobile.meaning: Managed mobile device compliance, policy and risk-signal changes.

chrome.meaning: Chrome browser and Chrome OS device events.

groups_enterprise.meaning: Enterprise Groups for Business membership and settings changes.

rules.meaning: Admin console security investigation and alert-center rule activity.

chat.meaning: Google Chat room and message moderation events.

data_studio.meaning: Looker Studio asset creation, ownership and visibility changes.

gcp.meaning: Google Cloud Platform activity billed to a linked Cloud organization.

examples.note: on gws:reports:data_studio, a placeholder capture value

event_type.format: One word or phrase naming the event's category within its application.

event_parameters.format: An array of {name, value} pairs (or boolValue/intValue/multiValue); the flattened columns carry one array-of-names and one array-of-values column.

examples.value: ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME, ASSET_TYPE, OWNER_EMAIL, VISIBILITY, CONNECTOR_TYPE, EMBEDDED_IN_REPORT_ID

admin#reports#activity.meaning: A Reports API Activity resource item.

asset_name.format: Free text, the asset's own display name.

DATA_SOURCE.meaning: A Data Studio data source asset (as opposed to a report).

PRIVATE.meaning: Only the owner and explicit grantees can access the asset.

asset_extra_attrs.format: KEY:VALUE, one pair; further pairs' exact join separator was not observed beyond one pair.

product_label.format: An unstructured string naming one Google Workspace product; the same value repeats across that product's rows.

change_action.format: event.name's own word (upper case) on signature; a lower-case, past-tense normalisation on action.

change_outcome.format: One fixed outcome word per changed field, present only when the report includes an outcome.
